name: kubevs
description: KubeJS development, visually integrated into VS Code.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm format:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kubevs/protocol build && pnpm --filter @kubevs/recipe-model build && pnpm --filter @kubevs/kubejs-parser build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
